examples.arabic: هي كانت محتاجة كتاب تاريخ نادر لمشروعها؛ أهو ده هو؟
examples.english: She needed a rare history book for her project; could this be it?
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet mehtaga ketab tareekh nader le mashroo'ha; aho dah howa?
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: بعد ما سألت كام بياع، لقيت واحد شايب كده عنده محل كتب صغير، قعد يشرحلها إن الكتاب ده نادر وغالي أوي وبيتباع بمية وخمسين جنيه أقل حاجة.
examples.english: After asking a few vendors, she found an old man who owned a small bookshop, who started explaining to her that this book was very rare and expensive and sold for at least 150 pounds.
examples.transliteration: Ba3d ma sa'alet kam bayya3, la'et wahed shayeb keda 3andu ma7all kotob soghayyar, qa3ad yeshra7laha en el-ketab da nader we ghali awi we beyetba3 be miyyet we khamseen geneh a'all haga.

examples.arabic: كنت بأسأل لو عندك كتاب "تاريخ القاهرة" للمقريزي، يعني هو نادر شوية.
examples.english: I was asking if you have the book "History of Cairo" by Al-Maqrizi, I mean, it's a bit rare.
examples.transliteration: Kunt ba'sa'al law 3andak kitab "Tarikh el-Qahira" lel-Maqrizi, ya3ni howa nader shwayya.
